ui.settingsHelpLanguages: Meditation Language controls the narration. Display Language controls the visible interface.
ui.settingsHelpChakras: Chakra Journey chooses the centers included. Reverse Journey changes the direction; Third Eye and Crown remain the closing centers.
ui.settingsHelpYoga: Yoga Bridge adds the physical sequence. Corpse Pose, massage, perineal care, assisted bathing, and standard bathing are optional stages managed there.
ui.settingsHelpModes: Music Only, Sleep Mode, and High Energy are selected in the Lobby. Sleep Mode moves through five sound stages; Experience Modes are selected for the current journey only.
ui.settingsHelpSave: Save the settings to enter the Lobby. You can review the final mode and timing there before beginning.
ui.sleepModeIntro: A quiet, sleep-inspired sound journey is beginning. You may rest without following instructions.
ui.sleepStageGuidance: Let the sound remain in the background. Nothing needs to be forced.
ui.droneDurationSleepNote: Sleep Mode starts at Intermediate and changes its sleep-inspired sound gently at each stage.
ui.droneDurationHelp: The drone begins before narration and gently fades after this share of the active practice duration.
ui.droneDurationHrimNote: For HRIM, Beginner is unavailable; Intermediate is the starting level.

ui.yogaFlowNote: Bath runs first, followed by Yoga, then the journey continues to Crown.
ui.mixerSubtitle: Tune the sound and comfort for this journey.
ui.mixerFrequencyNote: Changes apply from the next sound stage.
ui.restartConfirm: Restart this journey from the beginning? Your settings will be preserved.
ui.voicePaceNote: Pace changes apply from the next phrase.
ui.shotsHelp: One short frequency-only activation. No narration or background music.
ui.shotConfirm: Are you sure you want to activate this frequency shot? It will play without narration or background music. Before continuing, disconnect any Bluetooth or external speaker. Lite cannot disconnect it for you. Use your device's built-in speaker at a safe, comfortable volume.
ui.shotInvalidFrequency: Enter a custom frequency greater than 0 Hz and no higher than 20,000 Hz.
ui.safetySummary: Settle into a comfortable position and begin when you are ready to be guided. Keep your breathing natural; you may adjust your position at any time.
ui.consultationComingSoon: Session Consultation will open here in the next release. Your current meditation flow remains unchanged.
